summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing commercial close with the Tennessee Department of Transportation for the I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes project near Nashville. The Ferrovial-led DriveTN consortium, including Transurban and Tikehau Star Infra, will finance, design, build, operate and maintain new lanes over a 26-mile stretch under a 50-year concession beginning at traffic opening. TDOT selected the consortium in August 2026. No stake percentage, price per share, premium, or acquisition consideration was disclosed, so this is an ordinary project-award disclosure rather than a special situation.
